ModMetaData.name: Prisoner Interaction Timer
ModMetaData.author: CoolNether123
ModMetaData.description:
Shows the selected prisoner's live vanilla interaction cooldown, next eligible time, active interaction modes, and current blockers such as sleep, incapacity, or a missing eligible warden.
The timer uses RimWorld game ticks and never changes cooldowns, assigns wardens, or performs interactions. Optional per-prisoner and per-mode notifications fire once when a watched prisoner becomes ready.
